app.name: Sehat Saathi
app.tagline: Helps you decide how urgently to seek care, and where

health.title: Server status
health.down: Server cannot be reached. You can still use the danger-sign check.

common.error: Something went wrong. Your answers are saved; please try again.

danger.title: Is any of these present now?
danger.hint: Tap a sign to see what to do immediately.

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.lead: Get help now. Do not wait.
emergency.tell_who: The person's age, and if pregnant
emergency.no_wait: Do not wait for documents, money or scheme paperwork.
emergency.number_note: 108 and 102 (ambulance) and 112 (emergency) are from the National Ambulance Service guidelines, MoHFW 2026.
emergency.ack_done: Noted. Stay with the person until help arrives.
emergency.record_failed: Not saved to the server. The instructions above still apply.

capture.title: What is the problem?
capture.placeholder: For example: cough for two weeks, sweats at night, no fever
capture.record_hint: Tap, then let the family speak
capture.or_type: Or type what the family says

questions.title: Questions
questions.other_way: Answer in your own words or by voice

confirm.title: Check the facts
confirm.lead: Read each fact to the family. Tap to change.
confirm.checked: I have checked these with the family

urgency.LOW: Care at home, watch for warning signs

alert.title: Result
alert.missing_advice: Try to find out. If you cannot, refer for assessment.

reason.no_rule_matched: No referral rule matched. If you are worried, refer for assessment.
reason.no_pathway: Choose the main concern to get a result.
reason.pathway_not_applicable: These questions are not meant for this person (for example, their age). Refer for assessment.
reason.missing_facts: Some important facts are not known yet.

plan.title: Referral plan
plan.facility_note: Choose the usual local facility of this level. Facility lists are not loaded yet.
plan.not_diagnosis: This is not a diagnosis. A doctor will examine the person.
plan.no_referral: No referral plan: more information is needed first.
plan.show_note: Show the note for the doctor

facility.CHC: Community Health Centre or district hospital

bring.id_document: Any identity document, if easily available

extract.degraded: The app could not suggest facts this time. Continue by answering the questions.
extract.title: What the app understood
extract.lead: These are suggestions. Remove anything that is wrong; you will check everything again before the result.
extract.none: Nothing was understood from the account. Continue to the questions.
extract.concerns: Other worries noted (for the support step):
extract.none_scope: Nothing in this account matched the questions for this concern. That is fine: the questions will cover everything.

free_answer.label: Or type the answer in your own words
free_answer.not_understood: Could not understand. Please tap an answer instead.

speech.consent_q: Does the family agree to recording their voice for this visit?
speech.consent_why: The recording is turned into text and then deleted. Saying no is fine: you can type instead.
speech.mic_note: The phone will ask for microphone permission.
speech.too_short: Very short recording. Record again if something was missed.
speech.too_quiet: Very quiet. Hold the phone closer and record again if needed.
speech.transcript_label: What was said (you can correct it)
speech.asr_down: Speech could not be turned into text now. Please type instead.
speech.no_mic: The microphone is not available. Please type instead.

outputs.no_voice: This phone has no Hindi voice. Please read the text aloud.
outputs.copied: Copied. You can paste it into a message.

login.title: Log in
login.invalid: Mobile number or PIN is wrong.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
login.danger_note: The danger-sign check works without logging in.

support.title: Support that may help
support.lead: Information only. The family may be able to get help from these. Nothing here is promised.
support.more_none: This needs to be confirmed at the facility.
support.footer: Eligibility is decided by the scheme authorities. Do not delay care to arrange documents.
support.pregnancy_hint: Pregnancy is not recorded for this person. Record it on the person details to see pregnancy-related support.
support.ayushman_q: Does the family have an Ayushman card?
support.none: No scheme information applies to this visit.

about.title: Sources and status
about.lead: Every rule and scheme statement in this app is taken from these official documents.
